assets.name: chassis-skin
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production bitmap layer extracted and adapted from the approved Vault 443 landing-page concept in the reference image.
Reference image is the exact style and material source: heavy Fallout 1–2 inspired machined dark blue-grey steel, thick scratched brass edges, oxidized seams, tiny rust freckles, dramatic shallow relief, warm ivory reflected light. Preserve this specific realistic pre-rendered hardware treatment and frontal orthographic viewpoint. Original industrial artwork, no perspective scene.
This is one clean reusable website asset, not a new page mockup. Absolutely no text, numbers, lettering, symbols, logos, application UI, or watermarks. Do not bake any typography into the artwork. Broad even light from upper left and dark recess shadows, matching the reference.
Create a square seamless tile of the dark blue-grey steel sheet from the reference's left text area. Fine rough metal grain, subtle abrasions, sparse small rust freckles, rubbed graphite patches. Edge-to-edge continuous uniform material; no edges or frame, no bolts, no objects, no vignette, no large rust blotches. Keep dark charcoal-blue material readable under overlaid ivory typography, but retain realistic crisp texture. True seamless repeating surface.
